name: MCPJam Backend LLM first-ever paid spenders >75/h
aplQuery: | extend event=extract('"event":"([^"]+)"', 1, msg), spendingKey=extract('"spendingKey":"([^"]+)"', 1, msg), spendingPolicy=extract('"spendingPolicy":"([^"]+)"', 1, msg), modelSource=extract('"modelSource":"([^"]+)"', 1, msg), totalCost=todouble(extract('"totalCost":([0-9]+(?:[.][0-9]+)?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?)', 1, msg)), additionalCost=todouble(extract('"additionalCostToCharge":([0-9]+(?:[.][0-9]+)?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?)', 1, msg))
description: PAGE · More than 75 subjects made their FIRST MCPJam-paid call this hour (3-day lookback). Legit peak is ~60, and only on launch days.
THE RECONCILIATION TELL — compare against real signups for the same hour:
spenders ≫ signups → minted guests, not people.
rationale: WHY THIS EXISTS: on 09-15, 1,947 subjects spent for the first time against ~25 real signups — that reconciliation gap was the tell that the 'users' were minted guests, not people. Distinct-spenders can be pushed up by a returning crowd; first-ever spenders cannot.

HOW IT WORKS: rangeMinutes is 4320 (3 days) so the query sees 3 days of records, computes each key's first record, and counts the ones in the last hour. A subject returning after >3 days counts as new — acceptable noise. min(_time) comes back as a real (epoch ns), so the comparison MUST go through todatetime(); a bare 'First >= ago(60m)' silently matches every row.

WHY THIS THRESHOLD: measured hourly first-ever spenders 08-25..09-12: max per day 3-25 on ordinary days, 50-60 on two launch-shaped hours (09-06, 09-12). Abuse hours: 220-302. 75 sits above every legit hour and below a quarter of the abuse rate.

CONTEXT (2026-09-15 incident): $5,187 of MCPJam-paid spend in one UTC day. Every existing spend monitor fired correctly and posted to #mcpjam-alerts, but each is a single fixed threshold that notifies ONCE on crossing (Axiom threshold monitors only notify on state change; there is no re-notify while open). The daily page said '$107 is above $100' and then stayed silent while the day climbed to $5k, in a channel that also carries Sentry/PostHog/BE5 noise. Fan-out abuse (thousands of minted guests spending $1-3 each) moved the SPENDER COUNT 5-10x before the dollars did. This monitor set adds (a) a ladder of escalating spend tiers so a big day produces escalating messages, and (b) fan-out signals that lead the dollars.
SCOPE: only MCPJam's money — spendingPolicy=consume_mcpjam_limit AND modelSource=mcpjam. BYOK / record_only never cost us and are excluded (the older 'spend velocity' monitors sum everything).
